title: Cable tie is annoying
body: It dries my hair incredibly fast, but the power cord comes with a rubber cable tie that gets in the way when I'm moving the dryer around my head. I ended up cutting it off with scissors. A velcro strap would have been a much better design choice.

title: Storage box shows fingerprints
body: The hair dryer itself is a 5-star product, but the premium storage box it comes in shows fingerprints really easily. If you have any hair serum on your hands when you pack it away, it leaves a mark. Very annoying to keep wiping the box clean.

title: Instructions are too brief
body: The Airpro is very lightweight and quiet as claimed, but the included paper manual is too short. I had to go onto their website to watch the tutorial videos to figure out the Coanda curling effect properly. They should include a thicker instruction booklet.

title: Outer shipping box was dented
body: The product works exactly as advertised, but the brown cardboard shipping box it came in was dented on one corner. The presentation box inside was perfectly fine, but I expect pristine handling for my deliveries.

title: Support closed on weekends
body: I had a question about how to use the curling barrels on a Sunday morning. I emailed support and didn't get a reply until Monday afternoon! The dryer works perfectly, but if you sell a premium product, your support team should be available 24/7.

title: Gifts arrived in a different package
body: I ordered the Airpro but the Muuhu ScalpPro free gift didn't come in the main box. I was furious until the comb turned up in a separate package three days later. The products are great, but they really should warn you at checkout that the items might ship separately.

title: Courier left it on my porch
body: The hair dryer is amazing, but the delivery driver just left the package on my doorstep while I was out at work. He didn't even try to call me or leave it with a neighbour. Anyone could have stolen it! Very disappointed with the courier service.
